item.description: Fail-closed swarm orchestration tool that executes explicit task graphs with bounded concurrency and an epoch fence to safely reject late completions.

item.title: [news] Scaling Git at OpenAI
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from openai.com. 247 points and 169 comments.

item.title: [paper] Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations
item.description: Pixel-UMI is a pipeline that learns environment-aware whole-body manipulation policies from sensorized human demonstrations using retargeting and masking techniques.

item.title: [paper] Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation
item.description: Pixel is a co-designed full-stack robot system combining hardware, data collection, and learning pipelines for general-purpose mobile manipulation.

item.title: [paper] EgoActionBench: Benchmarking Dense Action Captioning for Egocentric Human Videos
item.description: EgoActionBench is a new benchmark and evaluation protocol for dense action captioning in egocentric human videos, assessing fine-grained hand actions.

item.title: [paper] From Natural Language to Exact Cover: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach to Zebra Puzzles
item.description: This paper proposes a neuro-symbolic framework that combines neural semantic parsing with deterministic exact cover solvers to solve natural language logic puzzles with improved accuracy.

item.title: [paper] WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
item.description: WebHarbor is a suite of 153 dockerized website environments built to evaluate and train GUI web agents using reinforcement learning on complex, multi-step tasks.

item.title: [paper] Pretraining Data Scale Reverses the Muon-AdamW Fine-Tuning Gap
item.description: This paper studies the downstream performance of Muon and AdamW optimizers after fine-tuning, finding that AdamW outperforms Muon when pretraining data budgets are sufficiently large.

item.title: [paper] Not All Reasoning Generalizes: A Case Study on Learning Generalizable Reasoning Strategies in RLVR
item.description: This paper investigates reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and shows that co-training with bijective inversion tasks prevents models from collapsing to brute-force enumeration under out-of-distribution shifts.

item.title: [paper] Isekai3D SDG: A Platform for Diverse Synthetic Gameplay Visual Data
item.description: Isekai3D Synthetic Data Generation is a platform that simulates and captures 3D gameplay to produce diverse synthetic video, images, and aligned metadata for vision and agent research.

item.title: [paper] FADE: Factored Ability--Difficulty Filtering for Online RLVR Scheduling
item.description: FADE is an online scheduling filter that uses a bilinear state-space approach to separate policy ability from prompt difficulty, improving reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

item.title: [paper] Thought-deciphering via hierarchical EEG-to-text alignment
item.description: Communication is important for our well-being, but it can be impaired by disabilities, such as locked-in syndrome (LIS), cerebral palsy (CP), and dysarthria.

item.title: [paper] D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models
item.description: D&A is a prompt-based approach that decouples progress estimation into a scene description phase and an assessment phase, enabling vision-language models to serve as zero-shot robotic reward models.

item.title: [paper] Strategist: Evolving Reasoning with Agents
item.description: Strategist is a meta-agent that automatically evolves, tests, and reuses inference strategy blueprints across tasks, reducing inference cost while maintaining high accuracy on benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Tracing the Scientific Discovery Capacity of LLMs to Their Training Data
item.description: This paper demonstrates that the frequency of singly observed facts in training data directly governs the scientific discovery capacity of large language models.

item.title: [paper] Benchmark Prediction with Sparse and Unpaired Cached Responses
item.description: Product Kernel Perspective Space is a method that represents black-box generative models using embedded responses to similar queries, outperforming baselines on benchmark prediction tasks.

item.title: [paper] Efficient Closure Learning in Dynamical Systems: A Comparison of Data-Assimilated and Embedded Approaches
item.description: Study investigating the cost and accuracy tradeoffs between embedded and staged data-driven closure modeling approaches for a synthetic epidemiological SIQR model.

item.title: [paper] ufakzeka-kulak: Building and Evaluating a 31.6M-Parameter Turkish Speech Recognizer from Scratch
item.description: ufakzeka-kulak is an open-source 31.6M-parameter Turkish speech recognition model trained from scratch to generate cased and punctuated text with word numbers.

item.title: [paper] Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
item.description: Reviso is an agentic video captioning framework that learns to prioritize key visual evidence through hierarchical planning and active perception, improving caption quality and downstream video understanding.

item.title: [paper] DiabAgent: Toward Agentic Physiological Control
item.description: DiabAgent is a research suite comprising a control framework, a simulator, and a benchmark for evaluating agentic physiological glucose control in type 1 diabetes.

item.title: [paper] Four Bridges: Measuring Deception Propensity in a Multi-Agent Game
item.description: Four Bridges is a multi-agent game platform used to evaluate and measure emergent deceptive behaviors and honesty interventions across frontier AI models.

item.title: [paper] Should We Combine Our Data? Algorithms and Limits for Privately Assessing Data Sharing
item.description: Algorithm that uses differential privacy to allow two parties to privately assess whether their sensitive datasets can be jointly fit by a single machine learning classifier.

item.title: [paper] Structured Visual Landscape: Generating Preferred Representations in Biological and Artificial Neural Networks
item.description: Vis-Lens is an image generation framework integrating a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model to generate realistic preferred visual representations for neural targets.

item.title: [paper] Spacetime Emergence in the Memory of a Learning Agent
item.description: Reinforcement-learning agent trained to maximize quantum mutual information, demonstrating that the causal structure of spacetime can emerge within an agent's internal predictive memory.

item.title: [paper] DynaSolver: A Neural Operator for Autoregressive 4D Flow Prediction with Dynamic Boundaries
item.description: DynaSolver is a neural operator for autoregressive 4D fluid dynamics prediction that conditions on boundary evolution to model unsteady flows around moving geometries.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating Uncertainty Calibration in Probabilistic Time Series Foundation Models
item.description: Framework for evaluating uncertainty calibration in probabilistic time series foundation models that reveals systematic patterns of miscalibration across multiple horizons.

item.title: [paper] A Scaling Theory of Multi-Epoch Pretraining: Late-Time Overfitting and Ensembling
item.description: Scaling theory and a dynamical mean-field theory for multi-epoch stochastic gradient descent show that ensembling reduces prediction variance in language model pretraining and improves compute-allocation laws.

item.title: [paper] 3D-BBDA: Backpropagation-Free Black-Box Domain Adaptation for Robust 3D Point Cloud Recognition
item.description: 3D-BBDA is a backpropagation-free black-box domain adaptation framework that adapts 3D point-cloud classifiers to unlabeled target data using only pseudo-label guided prototype alignment and logit fusion.

item.title: [paper] FedReady: Bounded Agents for Federation Formation
item.description: FedReady is a system that uses bounded LLM agents to perform federated learning site discovery, contract proposal, and local eligibility verification.

item.title: [news] Agentic backdoors via pretraining poisoning
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from arxiv.org. 103 points and 30 comments.

item.title: [paper] Sonar-MoE: In-Backward Expert Updates for Memory-Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Training
item.description: Sonar-MoE is a memory-efficient training method for mixture-of-experts models that updates each expert tensor during the backward pass to lower peak GPU memory.

item.title: [paper] NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains
item.description: NitiBench+ is a temporal Thai legal question-answering benchmark comprising 1,670 items across 17 domains that tracks historical legal text versions and court decisions.

item.title: [paper] VeriHarm-Bench: Measuring Harmful Success in LLM Coding Agents Verifiably
item.description: VeriHarm is an automatic evaluation framework that minimally perturbs coding tasks to generate programmatically verifiable benchmarks measuring unintended harmful side effects in language model coding agents.

item.title: [paper] BISECT: Bilevel Spectral Decomposition for Low-Rank Continual Learning
item.description: BISECT is a continual LoRA framework for vision transformers that splits a fixed rank budget into an invariant carrier and a novelty complement to prevent spectral starvation.

item.title: [paper] PlantVLM-Edge: Quantized Vision-Language Models for On-Device Crop Health Diagnosis
item.description: PlantVLM-Edge is a quantized vision-language framework combining agricultural domain adaptation and post-training quantization for conversational on-device crop health diagnosis on edge hardware.

item.title: [paper] MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks: A Cross-Framework Measurement Study
item.description: An open-source measurement study and tool called mcpvenom evaluate the susceptibility of 12 agentic AI frameworks to Model Context Protocol tool poisoning attacks that execute malicious instructions.

item.title: [paper] Nonparametric Intensity Estimation for Covariate-Driven Poisson Processes Using Deep Learning
item.description: Nonparametric maximum likelihood estimation using deep neural networks estimates the intensity function of covariate-driven Poisson processes without requiring intensities to be bounded away from zero.

item.title: [paper] Can LLM Agents Be Forward-Deployed Engineers? Requirement Discovery and Delivery for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
item.description: Study on LLM coding agents acting as forward-deployed engineers finds that the strongest models discover over 80 percent of requirements, but only 25 percent of execution runs pass all acceptance criteria.

item.title: [paper] Can LLM Agents Improve Imperfect Earth System Model Parameterizations?
item.description: Evaluation of AI agents synthesizing scientific literature and writing code shows that iterative feedback improves rollout error for most language models and enables them to produce executable parameterizations.

item.title: [paper] Variational Functional Neural Networks (vfNN)
item.description: Variational functional neural network algorithm optimizes physics-motivated continuum functionals using a quasi-Newton optimization method to find system states while bypassing differential equations of motion.

item.title: [paper] An Agentic Framework for Automated Power System Studies and Grid Connection Assessment
item.description: Grid Agents is an AI system that combines regulatory knowledge retrieval with power-system engineering tools to assist with grid connection assessments and studies.

item.title: [paper] CoLa3D: Composable Latent 3D Decomposition
item.description: CoLa3D is a lightweight query-based transformer that decomposes whole-scene latents into consistent object meshes, improving scene-level consistency and object-level quality.

item.title: [news] Preparing our next security sprint to harden OpenAI
item.description: OpenAI is preparing an internal security sprint with Cathedral Systems to test and strengthen its defenses using AI.

item.title: [news] Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties
item.description: OpenAI is raising its Security Bug Bounty rewards and introducing additional bonuses for independent security researchers.

item.title: [paper] ParaDeAl: Parallel Descent Algorithms for Sparse Statistics
item.description: ParaDeAl is a GPU-accelerated proximal gradient descent approach that enforces sparsity constraints and incorporates penalties to solve statistical regression problems up to 15 times faster than CPU competitors.

item.title: [paper] Contrastive Adapter Training and Consensus Knowledge Distillation for Multi-Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Skin Cancer Diagnosis
item.description: Skin cancer diagnosis, particularly differentiating melanoma from benign nevi, is challenging due to the visual similarity between lesions.

item.title: [paper] Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
item.description: Library of Layers dynamically orders transformer blocks during inference to adapt computation to tasks, enabling parameter reuse, sparsity, and interpretable routing across reasoning, multilingual, and safety settings.

item.title: [paper] Grading the Unannotated: Insights from the WorkRB Skill Extraction Challenge at RecSys-HR 2026
item.description: RecSys-HR 2026 challenge benchmark replaces binary skill extraction evaluation with graded relevance scores using a cascaded LLM judge and human validation to better penalize nonsensical predictions.

item.title: [paper] DistDebug-Bench: Can LLM Agents Diagnose Bugs in Distributed Systems?
item.description: DistDebug-Bench is a benchmark evaluating AI agents on diagnosing complex code-level failures in real-world distributed systems.

item.title: [paper] PanoTac: A Dense Three-Axis Tactile Sensor for Robust Touch-Centric Manipulation
item.description: PanoTac is a low-cost, compliant tactile fingertip sensor providing dense three-axis feedback to improve contact-rich robot manipulation tasks.

item.title: [paper] VIAS: Value-Isolating Activation Steering for Multi-Value Alignment and Compliance for Organisations
item.description: Value-Isolating Activation Steering is a method that isolates individual organizational value vectors to improve multi-value compliance in language models.

item.title: [paper] Ask, Don't Equip: Question-Driven Coding Agents for Deep Kernel Optimization
item.description: KernelSeek is a question-driven coding agent that optimizes GPU kernels without operator-specific knowledge or reference implementations.

item.title: [paper] RASP: Read-All, Sparse-Plasticity Continual Learning in a Stationary-Size LoRA
item.description: RASP is a parameter-efficient continual learning method for Vision Transformers that uses a stationary-size LoRA adapter with sparse gradient updates.

item.title: [paper] ST-GFM: Spectral-Temporal Graph Forecasting with Measured Perturbation Bounds and Masked Spectral Reconstruction
item.description: ST-GFM is a spectral-temporal graph forecasting model that uses Chebyshev and diffusion filters with masked spectral reconstruction to handle domain shifts.

item.title: [paper] A Cross-Domain Matrix Engine for Signal Processing and Deep Neural Net Inference
item.description: A cross-domain matrix engine dynamically reconfigures its architecture between a systolic array and a tensor unit to accelerate both signal processing and deep neural network inference.

item.title: [paper] Can AI Do Formal Demography? Why Vaccinating the Oldest Saves Both the Most Lives and the Most Years of Life
item.description: An experiment with the AI model Claude demonstrates how AI can simplify proofs in formal demography, specifically regarding COVID-19 vaccination strategies for older populations.

item.title: [paper] Online Label-Free Gradient Matching for Continual Language Model Training
item.description: OLGA is an online label-free gradient matching method that distills unlabeled text data streams to continually update language models efficiently.

item.title: [paper] Harder Than the Task: From Technical to Organizational Difficulty in AI Benchmarking
item.description: A study on organizational task difficulty highlights that current AI benchmarks lack adequate coverage of the complex relational and structural conditions found in real-world work.

item.title: [paper] A Hybrid Visitor Prediction Framework using Interpretable Temporal features, Integrating IQR and Anomaly Detection in Lakes in Nebraska
item.description: Hybrid visitor prediction framework that uses temporal features, anomaly detection, and ensemble methods to accurately forecast daily lake visitation numbers.

item.title: [paper] Identifying the Shear Piezoelectric Coefficient using Physics-Informed Neural Networks under Exact Boundary and Initial Constraints
item.description: Physics-informed neural network that incorporates exact boundary and spatial constraints to non-destructively recover the shear piezoelectric coefficient from sparse wavefield observations.

item.title: [paper] Tilted Convexity and an Exact Offline-Online Separation
item.description: Mathematical framework that introduces a distortion parameter to generalize convexity concepts, establishing an exact separation between offline and online optimization complexity.

item.title: [paper] A Bayesian Framework for Safe Optimal Control of Unknown Systems from Input-Output Data
item.description: Bayesian framework that updates state-space representations from input-output data to provide probabilistic safety guarantees and robust optimal control for unknown systems.

item.title: [paper] HIVE-Diff: High Frame Rate HDR Video Reconstruction from a Single LDR Frame and Events
item.description: Event-conditioned video diffusion framework that reconstructs high frame rate HDR videos from a single low-dynamic-range reference frame and event camera data.

item.title: [paper] Unrolled gradients in disguise: bridging interpolation-based and Jacobian regularization for stable neural dynamics
item.description: Unified analytical approach showing that training on interpolated samples and Jacobian regularization both approximate unrolled gradient strategies to improve the stability of learned neural dynamics.

item.title: [paper] Bg-Mix: On Using Image Backgrounds for Data Augmentation in Electron Microscopy Images
item.description: Data augmentation method called Bg-Mix that decomposes electron microscopy images into foregrounds and backgrounds to create novel training images and improve object detection performance.

item.title: [paper] Online Class Posteriors for Interpretable and Controllable Discrete Diffusion
item.description: Theoretical framework for discrete diffusion that tracks class-conditional posteriors online to provide interpretable token dynamics and precise logical guidance for generation.

item.title: [paper] Improving Hamiltonian Learning through Local Energy Decomposition
item.description: Local Multiscale Hamiltonian Neural Network that decomposes energy into kinetic and potential components across interaction neighborhoods to improve Hamiltonian learning and long-horizon rollouts.

item.title: [paper] Intent2CAD: How Semantic-Parametric Supervision Shapes Text-to-CAD Generation
item.description: Intent2CAD is a semantic-parametric supervision approach and dataset pipeline that generates editable, executable CAD programs from natural language descriptions while exposing reusable structure.

item.title: [paper] Error Accumulation in Second-Order Sequential Machine Unlearning
item.description: Method for analyzing error accumulation in second-order sequential machine unlearning, which uses Newton-conjugate gradient updates to achieve efficient certification and vanishing population-risk degradation.

item.title: [paper] Subpolynomial-Query Proximal Sampling Beyond Log-Concavity
item.description: Proximal sampling algorithm that uses a high-order noisy conditional sampler to achieve subpolynomial gradient query complexity for sampling from non-convex densities satisfying functional inequalities.

item.title: [paper] Playing Dumb: How a Chess Transformer Simulates Users Across Skill Levels
item.description: Method for analyzing skill simulation in a chess transformer, demonstrating that lower-skill behavior can be transformed into best-move decisions by fine-tuning only the final output layer.

item.title: [paper] Align Once to Explain: Feature Alignment for Scalable B-cosification of Foundational Vision Transformers
item.description: ALOE is a one-time, label-free feature alignment method that converts foundational vision models into B-cos variants to provide efficient and interpretable downstream explanations.

item.title: [paper] Bridging Neural Tangent Kernel Analysis and Reinforcement Learning for Deep Function Approximation
item.description: Temporal-difference flow formulation that extends neural tangent kernel theory to reinforcement learning, providing a closed-form solution for value function evolution and improving exploration efficiency.

item.title: [paper] Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis
item.description: CLEO is a method that fits a minimal agent harness to a self-hostable LLM, yielding a resource-efficient tool for evidence analysis in constrained environments.

item.title: [paper] A Living Leaderboard for Graph Machine Learning
item.description: Living leaderboard for graph machine learning that extracts and organizes benchmark results from peer-reviewed papers to contextualize architectural progress and baseline comparisons.

item.title: [paper] Evaluating Depth-Augmented Visual Features for Cross-Dataset Lunar Traversability Estimation
item.description: Framework that evaluates depth-augmented visual features for cross-dataset lunar traversability estimation, finding that training source choice dominates over naive geometric augmentation.

item.title: [paper] IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
item.description: IdeaTaste is a benchmark that evaluates how closely LLM-generated research proposals match human-published papers, revealing a significant gap in concrete research taste and execution.

item.title: [paper] Circumventing Magnitude Collapse via Modular Two-Stage Open-Set Recognition
item.description: Modular two-stage pipeline for open-set recognition that identifies magnitude collapse at scale and uses a magnitude-aware postprocessing baseline to achieve state-of-the-art performance.

item.title: [paper] Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Clinical Time-Series Models
item.description: The Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder learns a backbone-specific, patient-shared clinical concept dictionary from a frozen predictive model to produce structured, interpretable electronic health record representations.

item.title: [paper] Finite-Memory Control of POMDPs: Fundamental Limits and Efficient Design
item.description: RECAP is a constructive quantization method that designs representative memory states for finite-memory partially observable Markov decision process controllers to improve control performance.

item.title: [paper] DeliverBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Delivering Realistic Multi-Stage Professional Projects
item.description: DeliverBench is a benchmark testing whether large language model agents can successfully carry multi-stage professional projects from brief to final delivery across multiple tasks.

item.title: [paper] Low-Rank Clebsch--Gordan Coupling for Equivariant Spherical Forecasting
item.description: LCG-SFNO combines low-rank Clebsch-Gordan tensor products with a sparse GPU implementation to enable efficient, exactly rotation-equivariant spherical forecasting at scale.

item.title: [paper] From Reactive to Agentic Resilience: Multi-Timescale AI-RAN Orchestration Under Signaling Storms
item.description: A three-tier agentic AI framework coordinates open radio access network control loops across timescales to anticipate and absorb mass-attachment signaling storms.

item.title: [paper] VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing
item.description: VidDub is a two-step video dubbing model that uses replacement-aware cross-audio supervision to synthesize accurate lip movements while preserving source video identity and background.

item.title: [paper] Image Guided Depth Upsampling using Anisotropic Total Generalized Variation
item.description: An anisotropic total generalized variation method uses a high-resolution intensity image to guide fast and accurate depth image upsampling through convex optimization.

item.title: [paper] TaoMate-HD: Progressive-Resolution Autoregressive Audio-Video Generation
item.description: TaoMate-HD is an autoregressive streaming model that uses progressive-resolution generation and continuation training to produce synchronized high-resolution audio and video efficiently.

item.title: [paper] TaoMate-FVSR:Audio-Guided Facial Video Restoration
item.description: An audio-guided framework restores facial details in AI-generated videos by combining reference-guided flow modeling with audio synchronization to resolve lip and dental ambiguity.

item.title: [paper] Progressive Multi-Scale Super-Resolution via Cascaded Bicubic Anchors and Inter-Scale Mutual Refinement
item.description: PMS-SR is a progressive multi-scale super-resolution network that produces multiple output resolutions in a single forward pass using cascaded bicubic anchors and inter-scale mutual refinement.

item.title: [paper] CrowdForge: Effects of Audio and Visual Audience Participation Modalities on Agency, Collaboration, and Engagement in AI-Mediated MR Performances
item.description: CrowdForge is an AI- and mixed-reality-mediated performance paradigm demonstrating that visual and audio audience participation modalities drive user agency, collaboration, and engagement during live shows.

item.title: [paper] LAND: Learning an Adaptive Number of Draws for Bayesian Best-of-N Selection
item.description: LAND is an adaptive best-of-N decoding method that dynamically allocates sample counts based on score distribution variance, improving compute efficiency across machine-translation tasks.

item.title: [news] Claude Opus 5.5 Can Draw Permit-Level Architectural Drawings
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from stephenjgallagher.substack.com. 102 points and 34 comments.

item.title: [paper] Can We Stop the Backtest Yet? Anytime-Valid Promotion Tests for Adaptive Financial Research Agents
item.description: PROMOTE is a protocol for financial research agents that bounds the probability of promoting false trading rules through predictable testing wealth and cost-aware e-processes.

item.title: [paper] ASCoR: Asymmetric Semantic-Spatial Learning for Remote Sensing Domain Generalization
item.description: ASCoR is an asymmetric semantic-spatial framework for remote sensing domain generalization that uses SAM3 and dynamic adapters to achieve reliable predictions across unseen domains.

item.title: [paper] A Geometry-Informed Neural Operator surrogate of LISFLOOD-FP for rapid pluvial-fluvial flood forecasting: the case of Forlì, Italy
item.description: Geometry-informed neural operator is a surrogate model for LISFLOOD-FP that accelerates real-time pluvial-fluvial flood forecasting and large ensemble simulations.

item.title: [paper] RangeFinder: Predicting Ligand Property Ranges from Protein Pockets
item.description: RangeFinder is an SE(3)-equivariant transformer model that predicts physicochemical ligand property ranges directly from protein binding pocket structures to narrow the molecular search space.

item.title: [paper] Same Outputs, Different Scores: Auditing the Unchecked Graders of Multimodal LLM Benchmarks
item.description: Study auditing multimodal LLM benchmark scoring rules finds that unexamined response-parsing methods can swing reported accuracy by up to 22 points.

item.title: [paper] Mixed-Methods Exploration of Sociotechnical Factors to Improve Adoption of Crime-Reporting Apps in Urban Communities
item.description: Study using a mixed-methods design identifies perceived value dimensions like safety and anonymity as the strongest predictors of crime-reporting app adoption and actual use.

item.title: [paper] Characterizing When Language Models Take Harmful Actions to Protect Their Assigned Goals
item.description: Methodology for analyzing language model safety failures formalizes the trade-off between assigned goals and harmful actions under different elicitation protocols.

item.title: [paper] EO-Jev: Decision Model for Earth Observation
item.description: EO-Jev is a decision model adapted for Earth observation tasks through low-rank fine-tuning, improving accuracy, calibration, and transfer performance across public benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Fuse To Align: Multimodal Representation Learning for Retrieval via Hypergraph Regularization
item.description: Training-time hypergraph fusion framework connects observed modalities within and across semantically related samples to improve multimodal representation learning for retrieval tasks.

item.title: [paper] Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
item.description: Kev-Bio is a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection and produce spatial probability maps, improving biometry accuracy and reducing interoperator variability.

item.title: [paper] Multidimensional Suicide Risk Assessment with Machine Learning using Electronic Health Records
item.description: A machine learning framework combines electronic health record data, age-matched cohort construction, and calibrated XGBoost models to estimate multidimensional suicide risk and identify key clinical and behavioral indicators.

item.title: [paper] Neural Actor--Critic Learning with Minimax Critics and Reflected Langevin Sampling
item.description: A neural actor-critic procedure combines a regularized minimax Bellman estimator with a finite reflected Langevin sampler to establish finite-sample return guarantees and improve continuous-action policies.

item.title: [paper] Certifying Graph Neural Networks Against Label and Structure Poisoning
item.description: Deep Self-Training Graph Partition Aggregation is a semi-supervised learning framework that uses pseudo-labels and synthetic edges on graph partitions to certify neural network robustness against node-label and graph-structure poisoning.

item.title: [paper] NormMoX: A Normative Mixture of Experts for Explainable Autism Classification from Structural and Functional MRI
item.description: NormMoX is a normative mixture of experts model that uses healthy brain deviations to classify autism spectrum disorder from structural and functional MRI scans while identifying atypical brain regions and modalities.

item.title: [paper] FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell
item.description: FLAMIA accelerates Transformer attention on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs via MXFP8 and mixed-precision kernels that reduce quantization overhead, prevent causal leakage, and support variable-length packed documents.

item.title: [paper] ArabGeoText: Tool-Augmented Vision-Language Models for Arabic Geospatial Text Spotting
item.description: A tool-augmented vision-language framework combines YOLO26 localization, crop rectification, and adapted Qwen3.5-4B recognition to spot and transcribe Arabic geospatial text in raster maps and remote sensing imagery.

item.title: [paper] The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
item.description: The SIMPLE inference model is a four-parameter law that calculates the energy cost of large language model inference using architectural hyperparameters, accurately predicting prefill and decode energy consumption without per-model calibration.

item.title: [paper] From FAIR to AI-FAIR Metadata-First Infrastructure for AI-Enabled Science
item.description: An AI-FAIR metadata framework and agentic evaluation workflow extend traditional FAIR principles to provide bidirectional data integration and actionable feedback for missing metadata in AI-enabled ecological and biological sciences.

item.title: [paper] TrafficInstruct: A Multi-Task Network Traffic Dataset and Benchmark for Instruction Tuning
item.description: TrafficInstruct is a multi-task network traffic dataset and benchmark featuring 55,000 structured supervised fine-tuning records across ten tasks to support instruction tuning for network traffic analysis.

item.title: [paper] Steering with Multilingual Lexicons for Sentiment Control in Low-Resource Languages
item.description: Multilingual sentiment lexicons serve as a practical substitute for contrastive data in activation steering, offering a lightweight mechanism to control sentiment in low-resource languages while preventing linguistic collapse.

item.title: [paper] MultiInpaintCOCO: Fine-Grained Visual Understanding in Multiple Languages
item.description: MultiInpaintCOCO is a multilingual benchmark of 953 minimal-pair examples across 13 languages designed to evaluate vision-language models on fine-grained visual details.

item.title: [paper] LLMs Depend on Specialist Tools for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in MS/MS Structural Elucidation
item.description: A study finds that large language models require specialist de novo structure generators to successfully perform out-of-distribution tandem mass spectrometry structural elucidation.

item.title: [paper] Calibrated Multiaccuracy: Deterministic and Randomized Sample Complexity
item.description: A research paper resolves the sample complexity of calibrated multiaccuracy, proving a separation in sample complexity between deterministic and randomized predictors.

item.title: [paper] EventGPT: Next-Event Pretraining on Banking Customer Histories
item.description: EventGPT is a hierarchical causal transformer pretrained on banking customer histories to predict future events and generate reusable representations for downstream tasks.

item.title: [paper] An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
item.description: An axiomatic framework for reinforcement learning in open multi-agent systems uses Shapley axioms to derive value function learning and improve learning efficiency.

item.title: [paper] SQLoom: Set-Contrastive Learning of Syntactic, Semantic, and Logical Dependencies for Text-to-SQL
item.description: SQLoom is a constraint-aware fine-tuning framework that uses set-contrastive learning of syntactic, semantic, and logical dependencies to improve text-to-SQL generation.

item.title: [paper] Inferring Transferable Rewards via Active Inverse Reinforcement Learning
item.description: A two-phase active inverse reinforcement learning method selects environment dynamics to reduce uncertainty and minimize the expert demonstrations needed for transferable rewards.

item.title: [paper] ENGINE: Endogenous Variational MultiScale Optimization for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning
item.description: ENGINE is a zeroth-order large language model fine-tuning method that uses variational multiscale optimization to reduce gradient variance and improve convergence speed.

item.title: [paper] Top-$k$ Retrieval Leaves Memory Value Undetermined
item.description: LEDGER is a memory retrieval and valuation method that estimates determined Shapley values with confidence intervals while identifying undetermined memory values.

item.title: [paper] Mesh-Agnostic Refinement Models for Latent Space Encoding of 3D Human Body Shapes
item.description: A mesh-agnostic framework refines parametric 3D human body shape reconstructions by exploiting geometric discrepancies through latent varifold gradients, diffusion networks, and elastic optimization.

item.title: [paper] ReVA-HPE: Relative 6DoF Head Pose Estimation with Synthetic Pose Supervision and Personalized Virtual Anchors
item.description: ReVA-HPE introduces a relative 6DoF head pose estimation method using synthetic pose supervision and personalized virtual anchors, achieving robust metric query poses without requiring ground-truth anchor poses at inference.

item.title: [paper] Specificity Bias and the Wikipedia Paradox: An xAI Analysis of AI Text Detectors under Domain Shift
item.description: This paper investigates the robustness and interpretability of fine-tuned Transformer text detectors using SHAP, revealing systematic limitations like specificity bias and the Wikipedia paradox when handling out-of-distribution synthetic text.

item.title: [paper] On a Class of Non-Local Elliptic-Transport Systems in Score-Guided Probability Flow on $SE(3)$: Score-Singularity Resolution, Space-Time ADN Shift, and Markov Mean-Field Games
item.description: This paper establishes mathematical foundations for optimal spatiotemporal vector fields governing score-guided probability flows on SE(3), resolving score drift singularities and extending the system to Markov Mean-Field Games.

item.title: [paper] Strictly proper scoring rules for node selection tasks on graphs
item.description: Two graph-aware scoring rules, the Resistance score and the Diffusion score, are introduced for probabilistic node selection tasks to detect meaningful estimation quality differences that classical metrics miss.

item.title: [paper] Diverse-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Generative Recommendation
item.description: HERO is a diversity-aware on-policy distillation framework for generative recommendation that employs heterogeneous teachers and item rollout to mitigate popularity bias and improve recommendation diversity.

item.title: [paper] A Human-Verified AI Workflow for Annotating Environmental Sound Data
item.description: A human-AI workflow combining a fine-tuned Audio Spectrogram Transformer with human verification reduces environmental sound annotation labor by forty-one percent while maintaining high accuracy.

item.title: [paper] DeepWaveRL: Self-Supervised Full Waveform Inversion via Reinforcement Learning
item.description: DeepWaveRL integrates reinforcement learning into self-supervised full waveform inversion, reformulating policy learning to estimate subsurface velocity maps from seismic measurements without accessing forward operator gradients.

item.title: [paper] The Cost of Mismatch: Noise Amplification in Zeroth-Order Reinforcement Learning
item.description: ZO-BOLT applies zeroth-order optimization to a weighted SFT objective to improve memory efficiency and performance in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for large language models.

item.title: [paper] Rethinking Fairness Metrics for Multi-Class and Multi-Group Assessment: Not Everything is Binary
item.description: This work proposes generalized multi-group and multi-class formulations of fairness metrics to overcome the empirical assessment distortions caused by forcing non-binary data into binary simplifications.

item.title: [paper] Poisson Super Learning For Survival And Competing Risks On A Discretized Time Scale
item.description: The Poisson Super Learner is a scalable ensemble method for survival and competing risks prediction that combines interval-specific hazard learners under a common Poisson loss using right-censored data.

item.title: [paper] Anomaly-ranked confirmation slows new-class learning
item.description: Empirical study showing that concentrating expert confirmations at the top of an anomaly ranking makes new-class learning less efficient across physics, medicine, and computer vision benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] R$^2$-Omni: Reducing Structural and Precision Redundancy in Omni-LLMs for Long-Form Generation
item.description: Training-free framework called R^2-Omni reduces structural and precision redundancy in omni-large language models to improve long-form open-ended response generation.

item.title: [paper] A Common Language for Dynamic Graphs: Interaction Tokenization Enables Foundation Models
item.description: CL-DGFM is a common language dynamic graph foundation model that encodes interactions into tabular inputs for temporal link prediction without requiring target-graph parameter updates.

item.title: [paper] HyperFlow: Class-Incremental Semantic Change Detection via Hyperbolic Flow
item.description: HyperFlow is a hyperbolic flow method for class-incremental semantic change detection in remote sensing that models land-cover transitions as anomalies within a semantic embedding space.

item.title: [paper] Forecasting How RLHF Responds to Reward-Model Edits Before Training
item.description: Covariance-based predictor forecasts how reinforcement learning from human feedback policies will respond to reward-model edits before training begins.

item.title: [paper] ScienceCUA: Resource-to-Skill Construction and Execution-Guided Skill Evolution for Scientific Computer Use Agents
item.description: ScienceCUA is a two-stage framework that constructs executable skills from scientific software documentation and evolves them using execution feedback for computer-use agents.

item.title: [paper] Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
item.description: Axion 1.0 is an open agent foundation model trained via a simplified three-stage recipe involving self-contained reasoning, tool-dependent task construction, and reinforcement learning.

item.title: [paper] Calibrating Multimodal Test-Time Adaptation under Reliability and Availability Modality Shifts
item.description: AdaPGC is an adaptive probabilistic Gaussian calibration method that helps pretrained multimodal models handle reliability and availability modality shifts during test-time adaptation.

item.title: [paper] Bagel: A Fast Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection Algorithm for Linear Models via Posterior Merging
item.description: Bagel is a fast Bayesian online changepoint detection algorithm for linear models that uses posterior merging to maintain a constant computational cost over time.
